title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Now Includes Typeface | Typeface Integrations

Typeface Embed

# Typeface for   Salesforce Marketing Cloud

[Request a Demo](https://www.typeface.ai/partners-salesforce-registration)

![salesforce-hero@2x](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/Ve6sr1yyzHySYUFOPwiRG/51e53dbc90bc1a27fb2cb64e992c2d3f/salesforce_hero_2x_6f5d0cf828.jpg)

Generate multiple creatives in parallel for your audience-targeted campaigns, and seamlessly tap into Salesforce's built-in dynamic features to deliver tailored content to your ideal audience.

* * *

Key Features

## Scale tailored content to all your   audiences and campaigns

## Say goodbye to   context switching

Skip the manual image downloads. Drag in Typeface's powerful content block into Salesforce’s Content Builder. Then use our [brand-personalized generative AI](https://www.typeface.ai/product/hub) to create targeted, on-brand assets. Create, preview, and publish all in one go.

![salesforce-visual-1@2x](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/7bWntOY0T4yBx7gewCHMNy/5824e702334256b2168b813af01cd157/salesforce_visual_1_2x_9919c6d4ad.png)

## Tailor and localize content by audience

Need to run multiple [email campaigns](https://www.typeface.ai/use-cases/email-marketing) with different target audiences? With Typeface, you can easily generate creative variations for each audience, and Salesforce will dynamically send them to the right people.

![salesforce-visual-2@2x](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/lOVaX72tCVAtgn3HS2Vfv/1a761b37c7e795fce7f5f9e0235f4b8f/salesforce_visual_2_2x_c522c5b563.png)

## Edit without   skipping a beat

Quickly add text to your graphics, swap backgrounds, and position products using [Image Studio](https://www.typeface.ai/product/image-studio), without needing a complex design tool or waiting on resources for simple edits.

![salesforce-visual-3@2x](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/5WTukdJFfOnXRnDcaqT2Zs/f727a885df8bb841fb3741d7bb48dcbc/salesforce_visual_3_2x_144a878adf.png)
